conditions.matched_control: 50 MHz arm of the same physical run and image

memory_bandwidth.reason: The circuit retains the on-chip weights at both rates.

power_validation.reason: Module INA260 readings were used without external calibration or a whole-board meter.

prefill.reason: CPU TTFT and FPGA first-output clocks include work beyond prefill.

sustained_throughput.reason: Bounded paired blocks at concurrency one.

conditions.power_supply_boundary: INA260 VCC_SOM module rail, 20 Hz, five timestamp alignments and 75 ms contributing-gap limit.

correctness.evidence: All 200 timed, 36 warm-up and nine smoke replies preserved outputs, stopping, geometry and first/last/done counters. All 320 original BOS scores matched after restoration.

limitations: One KV260 and three fixed prompts. Four mixed pairs and two homogeneous pairs per prompt.
The Linux driver, clock tree and firmware divider readbacks establish configured rates. CPU timing cross-checks FPGA cycle counts.
VCC_SOM is the module rail. Active energy includes gaps and correctness verification across the powered block.
Clock probes run just outside the active window and can affect shifted sensitivity windows.
SPI1 and TPM counters bracket each active window and cannot isolate their individual energy contributions.
The first authenticated complete status caps the board execution time.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU admission through useful output and completion. Gross VCC_SOM block integral includes inter-reply verification and gaps.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact frozen reply, stopping, geometry and equal first/last/done clocks, plus exact configured PL0 readback.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three mixed or one homogeneous warm-up per powered block.

quality.evidence: All 200 timed, 36 warm-up and nine smoke replies preserved outputs, stopping, geometry and first/last/done counters. All 320 original BOS scores matched after restoration.
